title: For each subnet name and its gateway IP, find the maximum IP version among
question: For each subnet name and its gateway IP, find the maximum IP version among subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared', keep only groups where that maximum IP version is greater than 3, and also report how many such subnet name/gateway IP groups exist in total along with each group’s deviation from that overall average maximum IP version. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    s.name AS subnet_name,
    s.gateway_ip,
    MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version
  FROM subnets s
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM networkrbacs nr 
    WHERE nr.object_id = s.network_id 
      AND nr.action = 'access_as_shared'
  )
  GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip
  HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_groups,
    AVG(max_ip_version) AS avg_max_ip_version
  FROM qualifying_groups
)
SELECT 
  qg.subnet_name,
  qg.gateway_ip,
  qg.max_ip_version,
  gs.total_groups,
  qg.max_ip_version - gs.avg_max_ip_version AS deviation_from_avg
FROM qualifying_groups qg
CROSS JOIN group_stats gs

  SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, s.gateway_ip, MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version
  FROM subnets s
  JOIN networks n ON n.id = s.network_id
  JOIN networkrbacs r ON r.object_id = n.id AND r.action = 'access_as_shared'
  GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip
  HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3
)
SELECT subnet_name, gateway_ip, max_ip_version,

       max_ip_version - AVG(max_ip_version) OVER () AS deviation
FROM g;
